branded.why: A well-sold brand, but one supermarket brand among many, no part of a food culture of its own.

about.text: A brand of cow's-milk cheese: the curd is made in an industrial dairy in Ille-et-Vilaine, and it is ripened by Trappist nuns at the abbey in Échourgnac, Dordogne.

sources.text: The curd and its ripening, from these articles.
